provenance.note: Metres or yards. May also be shot with optical sights, scored separately (Revolver 1500 - Optical Sight, C.9.1.B). The trigger minimum applies in single action, or in double action when there is no single action. Optical sights are allowed in a separately scored class (C.9.1.B). A maximum muzzle energy of 600 J applies to the match.
